# Vendored JSON Canopy source

A copy of JSON Canopy 0.4.0 (commit 1edaee8 of github.com/OldPeasant/json-canopy), Apache-2.0, see
LICENSE and NOTICE here. It is the input for the `explorer-copy` task, which moves this code into
`packages/renderer` and then deletes this folder. Not built, linted or tested here.

- `src/app/json-explorer/`, `src/app/schema/`: the explorer and its schema support
- `src/styles.css`: the Tron theme tokens (dark and light) with the inlined fonts
- `samples/canopy-demo.json`: the demo document
